messages.subject: Downloading large data
parts:
Hello -

we have a Shiny app running where we want the user at the end to download about 500MB as a csv file. Shiny creates the file in /tmp/RtmpR2wB2e/file793e2d31b95 (the file names vary of course). Instead of the user being able to download, Shiny creates one file after the other with varying file names. Is there a limit to the file size or should we just try out other file formats (RData, binary, etc.)?

Thanks,
D.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Downloading large data
parts: There's no limit that I can think of and the type of content doesn't matter. Can you describe what exactly happens when the user clicks the download button in your app?
